english.notes:
(i) Section 187(1A) of the Act provides that an offence under this section may be charged by reference to any day or longer period of time and a person may be convicted of a second or subsequent offence under this section by reference to any period of time following the preceding conviction for such an offence.
(ii) Section 187(1B) provides that references in this section to contravening a stop notice include causing its contravention.See H9139 and see H9138
(iii) Section 187(2A) provides that in determining the amount of any fine to be imposed on a person convicted of an offence under this section, the court shall in particular have regard to any financial benefit which has accrued or appears likely to accrue to him in consequence of the offence.
(iv) Section 187(3) provides that in proceedings for an offence under this section it shall be a defence for the accused to prove that the stop notice was not served on him, and (b) that he did not know, and could not reasonably have been expected to know, of its existence.
